newsitem.title: ESTONIA: AMSERV SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED THREE TIMES.
newsitem.headline: AMSERV SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED THREE TIMES.

text.p: Amserv Group's share issue was oversubscribed three times according to a preliminary estimate, Hoiupank Investments said on Wednesday.
"The preliminary estimate is an oversubscription of three times but the final data will be ready by June 13," Mart Magi, the head of Hoiupank Investments, told Reuters.
Amserv, a car dealer, issued 100,000 shares in a public offering. The price of the shares, which have a par value of 10 kroons, was 97 kroons.
Its share capital is 2.89 million kroons, of which 19 percent is held by Japan's Sumitomo Corporation. The rest is divided between three individuals.
